data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to preview, capture photos/video and stream camera images.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget for live camera preview, methods to take pictures and record video, and an image stream API. Works on Android, iOS and Web.
use_when: You need direct access to device cameras for photos, video or real‑time image processing
You require a cross‑platform solution that supports Android, iOS and Web
avoid_when: You only need simple image picking without live preview
You prefer a higher‑level abstraction like barcode scanning only
weaknesses: Requires native permission handling and lifecycle management
No built‑in UI for scanning or advanced effects
data.setup_notes: Add camera and microphone usage descriptions to iOS Info.plist; ensure Android minSdk 24; handle app lifecycle and permission errors manually.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need QR/barcode scanning with a simpler API and less lifecycle handling
